message.content: {"note_claim": "The UK plans to transfer sovereignty of the Chagos Islands to Mauritius while securing a lease for the continued operation of the US military base on Diego Garcia.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "the UK would hand over sovereignty of the islands to Mauritius, while retaining control of the military base on Diego Garcia. It would lease back Diego Garcia for a period of 99 years", "reason": "The page directly supports the note's claims about sovereignty transfer and base continuation, but states the lease is 99 years rather than the 148 years claimed in the note, creating a partial contradiction."}

parsed.note_claim: The UK plans to transfer sovereignty of the Chagos Islands to Mauritius while securing a lease for the continued operation of the US military base on Diego Garcia.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: the UK would hand over sovereignty of the islands to Mauritius, while retaining control of the military base on Diego Garcia. It would lease back Diego Garcia for a period of 99 years
parsed.reason: The page directly supports the note's claims about sovereignty transfer and base continuation, but states the lease is 99 years rather than the 148 years claimed in the note, creating a partial contradiction.
